As the pet tech writer here on the WIRED Reviews team, I’ve tested over 100 pet-related products, including automatic pet feeders , pet water fountains , and pet cameras . The one brand I keep buying for myself—and recommending to friends and family with pets—is Petlibro.
Petlibro dominates the market for high-tech, seamlessly designed automatic feeders and pet fountains . Most of their products include a connected app to make pet parenting easier, whether you’re near or far. Where most pet tech falls flat, with poorly translated or confusing instructions and crowded, buggy apps, Petlibro shines. Petlibro makes it easy to monitor your pets: with real-time updates, scheduled feedings, activity logs, and reminders so you can always keep tabs on them and their needs. Although Petlibro products aren’t the cheapest, I still consider them a great value for how well-designed and reliable they are. But you’re in luck. We love the brand so much that we’ve gathered the best Petlibro discount codes and coupons to make spoiling your pet easier (and cheaper) than ever.
I could go on and on (and I have) about the importance of pet hydration, especially with cats. Cats sometimes struggle to consume enough water, which can lead to potentially lethal UTIs and blockages, especially in male cats. Unlike dogs, cats are generally quite particular in their likes and dislikes, and cats can see stagnant water as potentially harmful. If the cat was in the wild, stagnant water has more potential for harmful bacteria. Cats are more drawn to moving water in nature, and a pet fountain (like those from Petlibro) helps encourage them to drink more by emulating what they’re naturally drawn to. Read my whole spiel here for more information about pet fountains.
